statements.status_notes: Upstream advisory GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98 is fixed in Cosign v2.6.5 and v3.1.3. This image ships cosign 2.6.5 built from the v2.6.5 release tag, which includes the backported fix. Scout reports the Alpine cosign-2 APK as affected because its version range compares the 2.6.5 APK version against the v3 fixed-version threshold (<3.1.3).

Upstream advisory GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98 is fixed in Cosign v2.6.5 and v3.1.3. This image ships cosign 2.6.5 built from the v2.6.5 release tag, which includes the backported fix. Scout reports the Alpine cosign-2 APK as affected because its version range compares the 2.6.5 APK version against the v3 fixed-version threshold (<3.1.3).

CVE-2026-24122 affects the Alpine 3.23 cosign-2 package line, and the available fixed version is Cosign 3.0.5. This image is the Cosign 2.x track, and moving it to 3.x would cross a major version boundary. A safe remediation path for the 2.x track is under investigation.
